title: American Chicken Casserole
description: A classic comfort food dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Layers of chicken, creamy sauce, and a crispy top make this casserole hard to resist.
instructions: Cook the chicken breasts in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
In a separate skillet, sauté the chopped onion and bell pepper until softened.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked chicken, sour cream, shredded cheese, and cooked onion and bell pepper.
Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish.
Top with crushed buttery crackers and drizzle with melted butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
